witness.branch: Pedestrian roadway crossing at a provided overhead crossing.
witness.quote: Any pedestrian crossing a roadway at a point where a pedestrian tunnel or overhead pedestrian crossing has been provided shall yield the right-of-way to all vehicles upon the roadway.
witness.reason: A pedestrian road-crossing route can encounter roadway vehicles at the provided overpass without using its deck.
required_context: Establish a person afoot, the complete crossing trajectory and the crossing point's relationship to the provided overhead structure.
Establish an afoot ego crossing the vehicular roadway at the overpass location.
Establish roadway boundaries excluding shoulders and the underlying highway context.
Establish the other vehicle's actual position, route and purpose without inferring co-location or priority from the control.
Preserve the unresolved Section 11.30.070 exception, municipal definition applicability and uninterpreted right-of-way and crossing-location standards.
Retain roadway and shoulder boundaries, highway context and all vehicles upon the roadway, including their classifications and motion.
Retain the unresolved Section 11.30.070 exception and municipal applicability of supplied definitions.
Specify the other vehicle's actual position, motion and purpose and inventory all vehicles upon the roadway.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian actor can be realized as a person afoot; vehicle actors are not substituted for the obligated pedestrian.
